presentacion_titulo: I'm Edgar Milá, FullStack Developer Angular, .NET & AI
presentacion_texto: I'm Edgar Milá, Computer Engineering student at UOC and FullStack developer specialized in Angular, .NET and Generative AI. With over 2 years of experience, I currently work as a programmer at Soluciones IP in Cuenca (Spain), where I lead the Artificial Intelligence area as its sole owner, integrating AI (image generation, chatbots, document analysis and MCPs) into the Mobilia real estate CRM
